description:
Everyone remembers this as the sad teen romance book, but look who is actually standing on that ledge.

That's the heart of All the Bright Places by Jennifer Niven — and it's not the story you remember.

A deep analysis of "All the Bright Places" by Jennifer Niven — the characters, the turning points, the themes, and the one argument the book quietly proves. We cover what happens, what it means, and the reading most people miss, and we take on the book's hardest criticism head-on.

Best for readers studying All the Bright Places for class or a book club, and anyone who wants the real takeaway — spoilers included.
